notes.title: Progress Update #30
notes.notes:
Hi All!

[b]October 19th![/b] Our twin-stick shmup [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/347280]A Quiver of Crows[/url] is launching October 19th! Here's what we've been up to as we prepare for the game's launch:

[h1]October 19th!!![/h1]
Have we mentioned the game launches October 19th? Go [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/347280]wishlist[/url] it now!
[img]http://www.aquiverofcrows.com/images/swarmDeathGif.gif[/img]

[h1]Featuring a Song by Laura Shigihara[/h1]
Laura Shigihara is best known as the lead composer and sound designer for Plants vs Zombies, as the composer/lyricist/singer for To The Moon’s “Everything’s Alright”, and as the voice for the Singing Sunflower pet in World of Warcraft. We love Laura's music and we're super happy she contributed a song to our game! It's called "Better Days" - check out the music video below!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-72HWsAygDI
[h1]Behind the Scenes - Programming[/h1]
For you programmers (or aspiring ones) out there, here's a run down of the development environment we've used and modified to create A Quiver of Crows: [url=http://www.gamasutra.com/blogs/ChadAta/20160922/281854/Developing_a_2D_Game_for_Windows_Mac__Linux_with_Cocos2dx.php]Developing a 2D Game for Windows, Mac, & Linux with Cocos2d-x.[/url] In the post, lead developer Chad highlights the languages and frameworks we use as well as the modifications we have made to overcome certain implementation challenges.

[h1]Prepping and Testing[/h1]
The past month has mostly comprised of testing and prepping for launch. With all this testing, we're getting really good at the game! Which is good because we've also had to test the leaderboards a bunch too!

[h1]Launching October 19th![/h1]
That’s it for this progress update. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at [b]crows@sheado.net[/b] or start a discussion in our Steam community hub. And don’t forget to wishlist the game on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/347280]Steam[/url] and follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/AQuiverofcrows]@AQuiverOfCrows[/url] for more frequent updates!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/347280

notes.title: Progress Update #29
notes.notes:
Hi Peoples!

We're getting close to completing development on our twin-stick shmup [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/347280]A Quiver of Crows[/url]!
Here's a status update:

[h1]Music[/h1]
Alice has been working hard writing more music (while also polishing up some level designs). Here's the latest track she's created. Listen to it! It's awesome!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p1dzh7uujZE
[h1]Bugs & Beta[/h1]
The game is now entering its final beta. The team has been chipping away at testing while also fixing bugs and design issues as they arise. We're not doing a let's play video this month so that we can focus on these final tasks.

[h1]Animation vlog[/h1]
Danny's been uploading some short animation behind the scenes videos. In each video Danny shows an animated asset and explains which [url=http://esotericsoftware.com/]Spine [/url] (animation tool) features he used for creating some of the effects. We added a bunch of these videos to our Game Development playlist on YouTube - check them out if you're interested in animation:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CGqZrp8ol1g&index=10&list=PLtN-gbT-0zFIf7J4Q_MGlOt3FACDS7BD2 
[h1]T-Shirt[/h1]
We designed a [url=http://www.zazzle.com/a_quiver_of_crows_basic_t_shirt-235604324924529769]t-shirt[/url]! Actually, we wore these during MomoCon while we were exhibiting the game a few months ago. Buy one and represent your corvid spirit!

[url=http://www.zazzle.com/a_quiver_of_crows_basic_t_shirt-235604324924529769][img]http://www.sheado.net/shop/images/shirt_cropped.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Press Previews[/h1]
If you’re part of the press and would like to preview the game, please email us at [b]crows@sheado.net[/b].

[h1]Stay Tuned![/h1]

That’s it for this progress update. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at [b]crows@sheado.net[/b] or start a discussion in our community hub. And don’t forget to wishlist the game and follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/AQuiverofcrows]@AQuiverOfCrows[/url] for more frequent updates!

notes.title: Progress Update #28
notes.notes:
Hi All!

Another month, another progress update on our upcoming twin-stick shoot'em up: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/347280]A Quiver of Crows[/url]. We are finished with the gameplay aspects of the game - all 26 stages are done. We are now working on the details of the game that make it more polished such as achievements, sound, music, Steam controller, etc.

[h1]Developer Speed Run Let's Play Video[/h1]
Here we show off the Japanese localization, the settings menu, and speed run through a stage.
https://youtu.be/eEdzRCNcGgc

[h1]New Monsters[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8214857/d30b1557a10089dd48d7631ee61d78a22eb56539.png[/img]

[list]
	[*][b]Evil Eye Winged Creatures[/b] - There are currently three variations of these winged evil eye monsters in game. Their inclusion gives the game a very old-school shmup-y feel of bullet hell dodging.[/*]

	[*][b]Chained monster[/b] - no screenshot of this monster yet. They are like vicious chained guard dogs.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Weapon Upgrade Level 4[/h1]

This means all 4 different types of weapons now have a level 4 version. Plasma weapon has 5 simultaneous plasma bullets, the laser is now screen-length, etc. 

[h1]Settings Menu[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8214857/71a46947ef5789fce1b4059420080e8f4fdef23e.png[/img]

Want to play the game in windowed mode, without music, and with half the sound volume? Now you can! Controller customization is also available.

[h1]Localization[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8214857/8fb9ade71fe01659de2876c7683cc12964a1b6ff.png[/img]
The game will be localized to Korean, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, and French.

[h1]Press Previews[/h1]
If you’re part of the press and would like to preview the game, please email us at [b]crows@sheado.net[/b].

[h1]Stay Tuned![/h1]
That's it for this 28th progress update. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at crows@sheado.net or start a discussion in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347280]Steam community hub[/url]. And don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam and follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/AQuiverOfCrows]@AQuiverOfCrows[/url] for more frequent updates!

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi Everybody!

We were hoping to release the game early next month, but we've slipped behind schedule a bit. We don't want to release the game with missing features so we are going to have to postpone the release to Fall 2016. Sorry to keep you all waiting ːsteamsadː

The good news is that we only have 3 more levels to complete before we finish all of the gameplay for the game. Unfortunately though, as we were so busy working on gameplay we never got around to completing the other things such as a nice start menu, achievements, leaderboards, and settings. You only get one shot at a first impression, so we decided to postpone the release date instead of adding and improving things in updates.

Thank you for your support and understanding,
- Alice, Chad, & Danny

[img=http://www.aquiverofcrows.com/images/sunset.gif]

notes.title: Progress Update #27
notes.notes:
Howdy!

Time for another progress update on our upcoming twin-stick shoot'em up: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/347280]A Quiver of Crows[/url].

[h1]New Trailer[/h1]
We have a new trailer! It's been a while since our Greenlight trailer, so we figured it would be good to have a fresh trailer full of all the latest stages and weapons in the game.
https://youtu.be/J8i4KDbX5Ns

[h1]Co-op Developer Let's Play Video[/h1]
We finally polished the co-op gameplay functionality - check out our first co-op let's play! It also features a Sunset stage, new sound effects, toucans, beetles, and the latest weapons.
https://youtu.be/r4bVMnRHK1o

[h1]Award Finalist[/h1]
A Quiver of Crows is a [url=http://www.momocon.com/indie-game-award-showcase/]MomoCon 2016 Indie Award Showcase Finalist![/url] We're also going to be showing the game at MomoCon in Atlanta, Georgia. Come by and play the game if you're attending the convention.

[h1]Latest Additions[/h1]
We're adding more content into the game all the time now. The latest enemies we've added are the:
[list]
	[*]Toucan[/*]This enemy can become ghostly from time to time during which it doesn't take any damage. Pro tip: if you use the laser beam, you can hit this enemy when it's in a ghostly state. 
	[*]Beetle[/*]Don't be fooled by this thing's sluggishness. Let it get close enough and it will dart at you, horns first!
[/list]
We've also got some new upgrades:
[list]
	[*]Weapon Level 3[/*]With this upgrade, each of the weapons gains an additional spread or feature. For example, the plasma weapon now shoots 3 simultaneous plasma bullets.
	[*]Shield[/*]Pick this up and your crow is protected by up to three enemy attacks. 
[/list]
Last, but not least, we've been getting the Sunset level into the game. People seem to really like the pink colors in this one:
[img]http://www.aquiverofcrows.com/images/sunsetCoop700.png[/img]

[h1]Press Previews[/h1]
More press previews are being put up on YouTube and Twitch. If you're part of the press and would like to preview the game, please request your key via[url=http://keymailer.co] Keymailer.co [/url]


[h1]Stay Tuned![/h1]
That's it for this 27th progress update. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at crows@sheado.net or start a discussion in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347280]Steam community hub[/url]. And don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam and follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/AQuiverOfCrows]@AQuiverOfCrows[/url] for more frequent updates!

notes.title: Alpha Update Version 0.10
notes.notes:
Attention beta testers and press previewers - we've released alpha update version 0.10. Please give it a shot!

The update includes these new features:
[list]
[*] [b]Local co-op![/b] - You'll need two controllers for this. 
[*] [b]New Weapons:[/b]
[i] Sine Wave[/i] - this green weapon fires super fast and allows you to "spray" your enemies. 
[i] Sticky Bomb[/i] - a sticky projectile with a delayed explosion.
[*] [b]Third Upgrade[/b] - across all the four different weapon types.
[*] [b]Shield[/b] - protects you from three hits before disappearing.
[*] [b]New Enemies:[/b]
[i] Skull[/i] - spits out medium skulls which then spit out baby skulls. What is this monstrosity?!
[i] Spikey skulls[/i] - harder-to-kill monstrosity!
[i] Beetle[/i] - tough and slow moving, but get too close and you could get rammed!
[i] Toucan[/i] - randomly turns ghostly and becomes harder to hit. Who you gonna call??
[*][b]New stages[/b] - there are now 18 stages in the game. New areas include a junkyard, tropical scenes, and some new caves.
[/list]

[img]http://www.aquiverofcrows.com/images/tropical%20coop.png[/img]

notes.title: Progress Update #26
notes.notes:
Hey All!

It's time for another progress update on our upcoming twin-stick shoot'em up! 

[h1]Developer Let's Play Video[/h1]
Check out the latest developer let's play we recorded - sine waves, skulls, and more weapon upgrades!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wSdgCtLWOAk
[h1]Press Previews[/h1]
Last month we finally got around to completing and sending out the press preview build. A whole bunch of press and let's players streamed the game on Twitch and YouTube. It was really fun to watch their reactions, especially how different gamers handled enemy swarms when they happened. Here's a couple of our favorites:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XbzZ0J5P3oQ
https://www.youtube.com/watch?list=PLU_ZeWUJO1LZn1E5VqG9lol_9sQul8gTL&v=5CjI4ZYGb7c
[h1]Sine Wave[/h1]
We've been balancing and fine tuning the sine wave weapon. This is the fastest weapon in the game, but it's the lightest. It's good for taking out fast moving enemies like the wasps, but the light weight of these bullets makes them ineffective at moving heavy enemy corpses. 
[img=http://www.aquiverofcrows.com/images/sineWave480.gif]

[h1]Shield[/h1]
The stages are getting more and more difficult. Health upgrades already exist in the game, but for the later stages we're also throwing in shields to help players get through the really tough areas. 

[h1]More Stages[/h1]
A good chunk of development time over the past couple months has been spent on stage design and building. The Dawn, Morning, and Noon stages are complete now and we are now focused on the Sunset and Night stages. Check out this lovely work in progress screenshot of one of the Sunset stages:
[img=http://www.aquiverofcrows.com/images/sunsetShack.png]

[h1]Stay Tuned![/h1]
So that's it for this progress update. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at crows@sheado.net or start a discussion in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347280]community hub[/url]. And don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam and follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/AQuiverOfCrows]@AQuiverOfCrows[/url] for more frequent updates!

notes.title: Progress Update #25
notes.notes:
Hey!
Happy New Year!

Here’s the latest progress update on our upcoming twin-stick shoot’em up: A Quiver of Crows.

[h1]Developer Let’s Play Video[/h1]
For the tl;dr in you:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oHzAMlcJP1U

[h1]Dynamic Camera[/h1]
After getting a bunch of beta feedback we noticed a common issue in some of the comments: offscreen enemies sneak up on you way too quickly. We believe part of the reason for this is that the camera used to always be centered on our heroic crow. As a result, you could only see half a screen’s view ahead of you when flying in any direction. To remedy this, we introduced a dynamic camera that pans ahead relative to the crow’s speed and direction in order to allow you to look ahead as much as possible. So far, we’re finding that this new camera functionality has helped significantly reduce sneak attacks by offscreen enemies while also allowing players to fly their crow more quickly into unknown territory.

notes.title: November Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hey Peoples!

Here's another progress update on our upcoming twin-stick shoot'em up:

[h1]Developer Let's Play Video[/h1]
Watch our latest developer let's play video showcasing one of the latest stages as well as some newly completed weapons:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zm5Z0RXNQKY
[h1]More Enemies![/h1]
Over the past few weeks Danny and Chad spent a lot of time adding new enemies. Our goal is to introduce a new enemy every 2-3 stages. Among the latest enemies is a darting beetle, a floating urchin that shoots spikes all around, and a demonic flying eyeball that shoots a triple spread of bullets. 
[img]http://www.sheado.net/aquiverofcrows/images/dawn11.png[/img]

[h1]New Weapon Upgrade Level[/h1]
A Quiver of Crows is heavily influenced by traditional shmups that feature weapon upgrade pickups. We have just finished developing the 3rd level upgrade pickup, which causes the purple bullets to spread 5 ways, the plasma weapon to fire 3 parallel bullets, and the laser beam to reach further. With the level 3 upgrade the game has really started to feel even more chaotic as the screen fills with colorful bullets and piles of enemies. 

[h1]More Music![/h1]
Enjoy the latest track, courtesy of Alice: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YSB_xH6Fl-A
[h1]More Stages![/h1]
Alice has been working hard creating stages. She's nearly 40% done with all of our planned stages, and we hope to have another beta and press preview build ready soon.

[h1]IndieCade[/h1]
Last month we got to show our game at [url=http://www.indiecade.com/2015/indieXchange]IndieCade's IndieXchange Gametasting[/url]. notes.title: October Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hey All!

Another month, another progress update!

[h1]Developer Let's Play Video[/h1]
Fine tuning the pacing of the game has been our focus over the past month. Watch the latest let's play video, which covers the subject in more detail. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nvSQY3R1HvM
[h1]Pacing and the Stages[/h1]
We've done 3 beta rounds now and have made a ton of changes as result of all the great feedback we've been getting. The most significant of these changes affects the pacing of the game. Previously our stages were 6 minutes long with no checkpoints. The majority of players found it too punishing and tedious to almost complete a stage, only to die and have to start over again from the beginning. After weighing different options to address this issue, we decided to go with the solution of having very short stages with significantly greater difficulty. The result is a much more action packed frantic game, which is exactly what we're going for. 

[h1]New Weapons and Upgrades![/h1]
Over the past few weeks, we've also been adding and fine tuning some new weapons for our beloved crow. These include the laser beam, a bomb special attack, a sticky bomb special attack, and another upgrade level! The laser beam has been refined and now can pass through multiple enemies at once. Players will want to switch to this weapon when massive hoards are heading their way in tight quarters. In the special attack department, the new standard bomb is a nice alternative to the heat seeking feathers. This weapon has a bit of force, so it's useful for clearing away enemies and their ragdolling bodies. Similar to the standard bomb, we are also adding a sticky bomb, which players can stick to a clueless enemy! Lastly, we've finalized the 3rd weapon upgrade level, which results in a larger spread or more power depending on which weapon the player is using. 
[img]http://www.sheado.net/aquiverofcrows/images/laser.png[/img]

[h1]More Art![/h1]
It's "more art day" every day at Sheado.net. Danny's churning out more new art every day. Check out the latest forest he created:
[img]http://www.sheado.net/aquiverofcrows/images/forest2.png[/img]

[h1]Controls[/h1]
As promised, keyboard and mouse controls are finally in! We're still fine tuning the controls, but they are very near finalized.

[h1]Stay Tuned & Happy Halloween![/h1]
That's it for this month's update! If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at crows@sheado.net or start a discussion in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347280]Steam community hub[/url]. And don't forget to follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/AQuiverOfCrows]@AQuiverOfCrows[/url] for more frequent updates!

notes.title: August Progress Update!
notes.notes:
Hey All!

Hope your August is off to a good start! Here’s a summary of all the progress we made over the past month working on our upcoming twin-stick shmup: A Quiver of Crows.

[h1]tl;dr[/h1]
Rather watch a let’s play progress update? Well then – check out our first let’s play progress update video!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=493060565

[h1]Stages! Stages! Stages![/h1]
This is going to be a recurring theme for us now. We are in stage building mode and we’re almost done with all the stages for the Dawn level. In the Dawn level there’s lots of lush greens and blue skies. Some stages are outdoors while others are held entirely inside of large trees or underground. We’re also throwing in a couple of battle arenas to mix up the gameplay.
[img]http://www.sheado.net/aquiverofcrows/images/dawn.png[/img]

[h1]Map View[/h1]
In A Quiver of Crows you have 360 degree range of motion and you can explore any part of a stage in any order you want. In case you get lost though, we decided to go with a fog of war enabled map view so you can see where you’ve been, but not the places you’ve yet to visit.
[img]http://www.sheado.net/aquiverofcrows/images/map.png[/img]

[h1]Localization[/h1]
We’d love to support every language! But we can’t =/ So after careful consideration we decided to go with the following languages:
Spanish, Russian, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), and of course English.

[h1]Interview![/h1]
We had out first interview! Thanks to J.A. over at Obsolete Gamer for making our first interview experience a pleasant one!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?list=PLtN-gbT-0zFIf7J4Q_MGlOt3FACDS7BD2&v=Wg3wCXDxFfY

[h1]Stay Tuned![/h1]
That’s it for this update! If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at crows@sheado.net or start a discussion in our community hub. And don’t forget to follow us on Twitter [url=www.twitter.com/aquiverofcrows]@AQuiverOfCrows[/url] for more frequent updates!

notes.title: Progress Update!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow twin-stick shmup fans!

It's been a few weeks since the last progress update. We got lots of stuff done over the past month. Here's a review of all the progress we made developing A Quiver of Crows.

[h1]Gauges![/h1]
Everybody loves gauges right? In [url=http://www.aquiverofcrows.com/]A Quiver of Crows[/url] gauges will show you your health, current weapon, and current bomb. It'll also show you bomb ammo and weapon upgrade level. In the screenshot below, you can see one of the gauge designs in-game.
[img]http://www.sheado.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/CC6K5aKUEAA3ZHp.png[/img]
The design has evolved a bit since we started on it. Check out (below) all of the different variations we've considered. We're still tweaking the design for the gauges, but we're getting close to finalizing it.
[img]http://www.sheado.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/hudevo.png[/img]
Also, while I'm at it, check out the awesome job Danny did animating the heart! [img]http://www.sheado.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Heart2.gif[/img]

[h1]Vignettes![/h1]
Another thing we worked on was a vignette effect for when the crow dies at the hands of those demons and ghouls. Check it out in the screenshot below. We're still fine-tuning the color and shape of the vignette, but this is the type of effect you can expect when a pile of biters decides to overwhelm our dear crow!
[img]http://www.sheado.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/CBNzkIDUYAA2kyL.png[/img]

[h1]Dream Catchers![/h1]
Each stage exit in A Quiver of Crows is controlled by a fire-bound dream catcher. Once you complete the stage, the dream catcher's fiery spell will be lifted, allowing you to move on to the next one. Much of the work for the dream catcher is done, but we have yet to place it in a pretty environment:
[img]http://www.sheado.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/CBx0phJVEAElWTK.png[/img]

[h1]Damage Animation[/h1]
Visual feedback when your player takes on damage is quite important. We decide to go with a glow to red effect for the crow when it takes on damage. We're still fine tuning this effect too, but you can get an idea of how red the crow will get for a split second when getting hit:
[img]http://www.sheado.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/CCVxBUjUIAAbmN4.png[/img]

[h1]Upgrade Design[/h1]
There are a million ways to design a shmup. How do you upgrade? How do you downgrade? How do you get your bombs? Hundreds of shmups have explored different solutions with varying results, and so we spent a lot time researching and revisiting old shmups in order take away our favorite designs from each. The community at [url=http://shmups.system11.org/]shmups.system11.org[/url] has been extremely helpful in sharing ideas and opinions regarding shmup designs. If you're really into shmups, we definitely recommend you check out their site. 
  
[h1]Balancing![/h1]
Last but not least - gameplay balancing! This is perhaps one of the most important tasks we've been working on lately. We want to make sure the different weapons, bombs, and enemies are all balanced accordingly. So we've been doing lots of math and fine tuning to get this just right.

[h1]Stay Tuned![/h1]
Okay - that's it for this update. Thanks for reading and supporting us! If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at crows@sheado.net or start a discussion in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347280]Steam community hub[/url]. And don't forget to follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/AQuiverOfCrows]@AQuiverOfCrows[/url] for more frequent updates!
